title: S70 — PREREGISTERED probe: image-side case instrument v1 (x-height / cap-ratio)
desc: PREREGISTERED BOUNDED PROBE. EVIDENCE: reports/case-instrument/prereg.md then result.md (+receipts) + PUSHES rows + formalcode lines. BOUNDARIES: probe only — no shipping edits without review; NO-GO gets published too. Boundaries: no edits to shipping paths unless the task says so; no tuning on canonical seeds 1/2/3/4/53 (evaluation only); honest numbers — no 98/95 claims; captchaproject(s) off-limits.
